statement: In Illinois you change your legal name by filing a Request for Name Change in the circuit court of the county where you live, and a judge signs an order granting it.
detail: Illinois usually requires newspaper publication of the request, but a court can waive publication when it could endanger the petitioner — this is decided by the judge.

cost.note: Filing fees vary by county; a fee waiver is available, and publication may add a separate newspaper cost.

timeline.typical: roughly 6 weeks, partly driven by the publication period

source.title: Illinois Legal Aid Online — Changing Your Name (Adult)

statement: Illinois lets you choose the sex designation on your driver's license or state ID — including a nonbinary X option — by self-certifying with the Secretary of State; medical documentation is not required.

cost.note: No additional fee to update the designation during another transaction.

source.title: Illinois Legal Aid Online — Updating Sex and Gender Markers on ID
